pattern.description: The whole chat thread scrolls upward inside the 'Customer conversation' column; earlier messages slide out under a top mask beneath the heading while a new customer 'Thank you' message rises in from below and settles near the top.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous eased scroll replaces a cut, so the conversation feels like a real live thread advancing in time; the fixed heading and soft top mask keep the layout stable while content changes.

build_hint.gsap: Wrap messages in an overflow-hidden column with a top gradient mask; gsap.to('.thread', {y: -scrollDistance, duration: 1.3, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); the new '.msg-thankyou' row is part of the thread (or gsap.fromTo it with {y: 80} → {y: 0}, same ease) so all rows move as one.
